newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ATHLETICS-WORLD CHAMPION KIPKETER BREAKS WORLD RECORD.
newsitem.headline: ATHLETICS-WORLD CHAMPION KIPKETER BREAKS WORLD RECORD.

text.p: Kenya's newly-crowned world champion Wilson Boit Kipketer broke the men's 3,000 metres steeplechase world record on Wednesday after a fierce battle with former holder and compatriot Moses Kiptanui.
Kipketer held off Kiptanui and compatriot Bernard Barmasai in a tight finish at the Zurich grand prix to clock seven minutes 59.08 seconds.
The previous record of 7:59.18 was set by Kiptanui on the same Zurich track in August 1995.
Kiptanui, who had to settle for second place behind Kipketer at this month's world championships in Athens, finished third in 8:00.78 behind second-placed Barmasai who ran 8:00.35.
The performance was worth a world record bonus of $50,000 to Kipketer plus one kilo of gold.
